name: Montana
agency: Montana Department of Justice, Motor Vehicle Division (MVD), Driver License Bureau
permitAge: 14 1/2 if participating in or finished a state-approved traffic education course; otherwise 16, or 15 after finishing approved traffic education (Montana Driver Manual pp. 2, 8; MCA 61-5-106)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night (Driver Manual p. 7)
teen.holdPermit: 6 consecutive months for drivers under 18 (p. 8); learner license valid 1 year
teen.nightLimit: First-year restricted license: no driving 11 p.m. to 5 a.m., with exceptions such as emergencies, farm work, school, church, work and parent-authorized trips (p. 8; MCA 61-5-133)
teen.passengerLimit: First 6 months: at most one unrelated passenger under 18 unless supervised by a licensed adult; second 6 months: at most three; restrictions end after 1 year or at 18, whichever is first (p. 8; MCA 61-5-133)
teen.phone: No statewide hand-held or texting ban; the manual says most Montana cities have their own bans (p. 49). SB 359 (2025) failed in the Senate.

notes: Official manual used: Montana Driver Manual, MVD (Department of Justice), cover says 'Revised October 2018'; PDF hosted by the Office of Public Instruction (opi.mt.gov), PDF last modified June 2021. dojmt.gov returns a Cloudflare bot-check page, so the MVD site itself could not be read. No Spanish manual found.
Exam figures (33 questions, 27 to pass) are from secondary practice-test sites only; the manual does not give the test size or pass mark and dojmt.gov could not be read. Test languages unknown.

The 2018 manual is out of date on: insurance (says 25/50/10; MCA 61-6-103 in the 2025 code says 25/50/20); move-over (61-8-346 repealed 2023, replaced by 61-8-388: slow down by set amounts and move to a non-adjacent lane); interstate limit (table shows 75/80; MCA 61-8-303 says 80 outside urbanized areas of 50,000+, 65 inside).
Learner under 18: supervised by a parent/guardian or, with permission, a licensed driver 18 or older (MCA 61-5-106); everyone belted (manual p. 7).
Restricted license: every occupant belted, no more occupants than belts (MCA 61-5-133). Violations: 20-60 hours community service first offense, 6-month suspension second (p. 8).

Speed (MCA 61-8-303, 2025 code): 80 mph rural interstate, 65 mph interstate in urbanized areas of 50,000+, 75/70 on four-lane national highways, 70 day / 65 night other highways, 25 mph urban district; +10 mph only to pass on a two-lane road in a passing zone. Daytime = 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset. Manual p. 38 table: two-lane 70/65, urban interstates (Billings, Great Falls, Missoula) 65.
School bus: stop at least 30 feet away from either direction for flashing red lights; no stop needed for a bus on a separate roadway (p. 40; MCA 61-8-351(7)).
Seat belts: driver responsible for all occupants, $20 fine (p. 19); adult enforcement secondary, primary for child under 6 and under 60 lb (MCA 61-13-103(3)).
Open range: 'Range Cattle' sign means no fences, cattle and horses may be on the road (p. 25); stop for animals crossing your path (p. 67).
